name: journal-{DAY}
title: Journal {DAY}
subtitle: What was decided and covered, and what followed: every recorded call (only when a course, grade or plan changed) and every covered name per day, measured on the panel store at 1 day to 6 months against the median store name. Each column is one read; nothing is summed, nothing is filtered: small samples show their n, names and days.
sources_extra: journal logs/tradingview_analysis/journal/journal.duckdb (tv_scan_cli.py journal record / note / backfill; config/generic_utils/journal.json)
review {PACK}/journal (tv_scan_cli.py journal review --pack {PACK}); prices and labels from the panel store

blocks.title: Calls by class: raw, excess over the median store name (fx), signed excess (sfx: + when the call was right) and the kill touched, from the call to each horizon and to the newest close (_now)

source.sql: SELECT cls, n, n_names, first_day, last_day, fx_now_mean, sfx_now_mean, n_7d, fx_7d_mean, fx_7d_hit, sfx_7d_mean, n_28d, fx_28d_mean, fx_28d_hit, sfx_28d_mean, kill_28d_share, n_56d, fx_56d_mean, n_91d, fx_91d_mean, sfx_91d_mean, n_182d, fx_182d_mean FROM scorecard
SELECT cls, grade, n, n_7d, fx_7d_mean, fx_7d_hit, sfx_7d_mean, n_28d, fx_28d_mean, fx_28d_hit, sfx_28d_mean, n_91d, fx_91d_mean FROM by_grade

blocks.title: Covered names by pack list and by the call in force, split by breadth and the market's month (one observation per name per day: windows overlap, read n_names and n_days)

source.sql: SELECT study, cell, n, n_names, n_days, n_7d, fx_7d_mean, fx_7d_hit, n_28d, fx_28d_mean, fx_28d_med, fx_28d_hit, n_56d, fx_56d_mean, n_91d, fx_91d_mean, n_182d, fx_182d_mean FROM studies WHERE study IN ('list', 'list x regime', 'cls', 'cls x regime', 'cls x trend21') ORDER BY study, n DESC

blocks.title: Pack reads at the time: band state, model decile, letters, event warning, peer gap

source.sql: SELECT study, cell, n, n_names, n_days, n_7d, fx_7d_mean, fx_7d_hit, n_28d, fx_28d_mean, fx_28d_hit, n_91d, fx_91d_mean FROM studies WHERE study NOT IN ('list', 'list x regime', 'cls', 'cls x regime', 'cls x trend21') ORDER BY study, n DESC

blocks.text: Dated notes: OUTSIDE news, guidance, sentiment and lessons (tv_scan_cli.py journal note --ids ... --kind ... --text ... --source ...), plus the print brief's OUTSIDE lines and each update banner harvested from the judgment.
